description: Implementation of PSR HTTP streams, defining the Stream class that manages stream resources, including reading, writing, seeking, and metadata handling.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: A class implementing PSR-7 StreamInterface for managing stream resources, including methods for reading, writing, seeking, and metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Stream object with a string or resource and optional mode.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the stream contents as a string, rewinding if seekable.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the resource from the stream.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches a new resource or string to the stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if available.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the file pointer.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at end-of-file.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is seekable.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns remaining contents of the stream.

methods.name: setStream
methods.description: Sets the internal stream resource, opening a string as a stream if needed.

methods.name: isValidStreamResourceType
methods.description: Checks if a resource is of an allowed type for stream.
